description: This file defines the 'Node' class which implements the 'NodeInterface' for managing hierarchical data using the nested set model within an ORM framework. It includes methods for retrieving parent/child nodes, inserting, deleting, and manipulating nested set nodes, and interfaces with Doctrine ORM for database operations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Implements a node in a nested set hierarchy, providing methods for hierarchical data management such as retrieving children and parent nodes, inserting, deleting, and checking node properties, using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Returns true if the node has children, based on the presence of nested set children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child nodes up to a specified depth using Doctrine query builder.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Determines if the current node has a parent node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent node of the current node, if it exists.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level (depth) of the node within the hierarchy.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of a specified parent node, updating nested set left/right values within a transaction.

methods.name: shiftRlValues
methods.description: Shifts left and right values of nodes starting from a specified position, used when inserting or deleting nodes.

methods.name: persistNode
methods.description: Persists the current node with specified left and right values to the database.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node by inserting it as the last child.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf (has no children) based on left/right value difference.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root node (left value is 1).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the node and its descendants from the database, adjusting the nested set values accordingly within a transaction.
